strategy.overview: Space Train rewards repeated target-bank completions, the three captive balls, and the M-A-C lanes. Complete the target bank to advance its award sequence: Bonus X with upper Extra Ball, then Bonus X with captive-ball Extra Ball, then Bonus X with Extra Ball and Special. Hit the center captive ball to advance Hole Bonus; the right captive ball lights 30,000 on the center balls. Complete M-A-C to light Special at the lower lane.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Space Train, keep completing the target bank: its sequence adds Bonus X and upper Extra Ball, then captive-ball Extra Ball, then Extra Ball and Special. Hit the center captive ball to advance Hole Bonus and the right captive ball to light 30,000 on the center balls. Complete M-A-C to light Special at the lower lane.
strategy.summary: Make the target bank the main route because each completion advances the award sequence. Use the right captive ball before the center balls for their 30,000 values, and take M-A-C lanes whenever the ball reaches the top.

quickInfo.name: Advance the award sequence
quickInfo.summary: Complete the target bank repeatedly for Bonus X, Extra Ball, and Special.

quickInfo.name: Build Hole Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center captive ball to advance Hole Bonus and score 30,000 when lit.

quickInfo.name: Light center-ball value
quickInfo.summary: Hit the right captive ball to light 30,000 on the center captive balls.

steps.text: Complete the target bank once to advance the combination to Bonus X and upper Extra Ball.
Complete the bank again for Bonus X and captive-ball Extra Ball, then a third time for Bonus X, Extra Ball, and Special.
Hit the right captive ball to light 30,000 on the center captive balls, then hit the center ball to score the lit value and advance Hole Bonus.
Complete M-A-C in the upper lanes to light Special at the lower lane.

alternatives.title: Hole Bonus route
alternatives.when: Use this when the captive balls are easier to repeat than the target bank.

steps.text: Hit the right captive ball to light 30,000 on the center balls.
Repeat the center captive ball to advance Hole Bonus.
When upper Hole Bonus reaches 2, collect its Extra Ball at the matching hole.

buildsToward.title: Bonus X, Extra Ball, and Special

steps.text: Repeat complete target-bank cycles through all three award stages.
Build and collect Hole Bonus with the captive balls and matching holes.
Complete M-A-C for the lower-lane Special.

machineSetup: Test every target-bank switch, all three captive-ball switches, both upper-level shooter holes, the M-A-C lanes, and each lower and upper Hole Bonus collect.
Confirm the installed target-bank award order, Bonus X ceiling, Extra Ball conversion, Special conversion, and multiball release behavior before competitive play.

cautions.issue: Operator settings can change award conversions and the target-bank sequence.
cautions.response: Read the active Bonus X, Extra Ball, and Special lamps before committing to the next bank completion.
